instruction: A candid family photograph in an eye-level full shot captures a playful morning scene. In a cozy bedroom with patterned wallpaper and a white bed, the bearded man in a white t-shirt and striped pajama pants (R1) planks on a woven rug, smiling directly at the camera. The woman in a white button-up shirt and matching pants (R3) sits on his lower back, smiling warmly. She holds the toddler in striped pajamas (R2) steady as the child stands upright on the man's back, looking slightly downward. Soft, natural indoor light fills the room, creating a warm and cheerful atmosphere.
